captions_meta.li_hook:
A year-end release published after the peak has almost no news value.
The window is now, and it closes with the holidays.
li_body: Between 12.12, Christmas and New Year, newsrooms run lean and inboxes run full. Releases that land before the slowdown have a far better chance of being picked up and shared.
What you can do this week with VRITIMES:
li_points: Distribute your year-end promo, results or January announcement with guaranteed media placement (count depends on plan).
Point the backlink to your promo or product page.
Use the distribution report to review the campaign and plan Q1.
captions_meta.li_close: Current plans and pricing are on our official page.
captions_meta.fb: Don't let your year-end news land after everyone's gone on leave 😅 See VRITIMES plans here 👇
